notes:
Fieldbook 1.4.5: MS Project-style work package information

- The work package editor is now a large page with tabs: General,
  Predecessors, Resources & outputs, Advanced, Notes, Linked tasks
- General: code (WBS), name, part of, milestone switch, start, finish,
  duration and working days kept in step, % complete
- Predecessors: several links per item, each Finish-Start, Start-Start,
  Finish-Finish or Start-Finish with a lag (minus = overlap); successors list
- Advanced: constraints (start/finish no earlier/later than, must start/finish
  on), deadline with a marker on the bar, warnings for broken links and dates
- Scheduling pushes linked items for every link type and respects constraints;
  arrows are drawn for each link type
- Info sheet shows predecessors, successors, constraint, deadline, warnings
